item.text:
**Bottom Line**
The 2024 record does not show Shehbaz Sharif building a durable accountability architecture for police, military, intelligence, prisons, or politically protected actors. The best pro-accountability evidence is limited and mostly reactive: one inquiry commission into alleged ISI intimidation of judges, a functioning federal complaint system, and prison-reform orders. The stronger body of evidence points the other way: weak punishment of abusers, judicial weakening, and continued abuse of opponents and minorities. Confidence: moderate.

**Evidence**
- [Pakistan will set up inquiry commission to investigate army’s meddling in judiciary, law minister says](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/3/28/pakistan-to-investigate-armys-meddling-in-judiciary-law-minister-says) | Reuters via Al Jazeera | 2024-03-28 | After six High Court judges alleged ISI intimidation in politically sensitive cases, the Sharif government said it would form an inquiry commission. This is the clearest 2024 sign of independent investigation of abuse by a politically protected actor. IDs: `3B.4`, also `3B.1`, `3B.2`

- [Mohtasib resolves 193,028 complaints, provides relief of Rs 4.898 billion](https://president.gov.pk/mohtasib-resolves-193028-complaints-provides-relief-of-rs-4898-billion-2) | President of Pakistan | 2024-02-07 | The federal ombudsman processed a large volume of complaints against government departments and provided relief to citizens. This shows complaint-handling infrastructure was active in 2024, though it is an inherited institution rather than a clearly Sharif-built reform. IDs: `3B.4`

- [World Report 2024: Pakistan](https://www.hrw.org/world-report/2024/country-chapters/pakistan) | Human Rights Watch | 2024 | HRW reported that, after its prison-health reporting, Sharif ordered measures to improve sanitation and healthcare in Lahore Central Prison and vowed prison reforms nationwide. This is a limited prison-reform step, but it reads as reactive rather than a durable civilian-oversight system. IDs: `3B.4`

- [2024 Country Reports on Human Rights Practices: Pakistan](https://www.ecoi.net/en/document/2128431.html) | U.S. Department of State | 2024 | The report says the government rarely took credible steps to identify and punish officials who committed abuses. That is strong evidence against effective accountability for state violence and abuse. IDs: `3B.4`, also `3B.1`, `3B.2`

- [Pakistan's government curbs judiciary's power after alleged harassment of MPs](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2024/oct/21/pakistans-government-curbs-judiciarys-power-after-alleged-harassment-of-mps) | The Guardian | 2024-10-21 | The 26th amendment was passed amid allegations of intimidation and abductions of MPs, and critics said it reduced judicial independence and weakened the courts as a check on power. This cuts directly against building independent oversight of abuse by politically protected actors. IDs: `3B.4`, also `3B.1`, `3B.2`

- [Pakistan: Widening Crackdown on Dissent](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/01/11/pakistan-widening-crackdown-dissent) | Human Rights Watch | 2024-01-11 | HRW said the government clamped down on dissenting media, the opposition, and NGOs, and that deportations of undocumented Afghans occurred without safeguards against police abuse. This is evidence against a serious due-process and complaint-protection posture. IDs: `3B.4`, also `3B.1`, `3B.2`

- [End escalating attacks on minority Ahmadiyya community](https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/06/end-escalating-attacks-on-minority-ahmadiyya-community/) | Amnesty International | 2024-06-21 | Amnesty documented arbitrary arrests, police harassment, and orders blocking Ahmadi rites, showing that abusive local enforcement was not being effectively checked. IDs: `3B.4`, also `3B.1`, `3B.2`

**Search Gap**
I did not find 2024 evidence of Sharif creating a new, durable civilian oversight body, police complaint authority, prison inspectorate, or independent abuse-investigation mechanism specifically under his government. The affirmative evidence is narrow and mostly reactive; the broader 2024 record still points to weak accountability.
